title: GitHub Actions Self-Hosted Control Plane v1
goal: Eliminate routine dependence on metered GitHub-hosted runners by moving workspace-control and project CI onto bounded self-hosted Lambda execution while preserving a non-circular bootstrap authority, per-project isolation, fail-closed admission, review gates, and a clean path to GitHub organization runner groups. Also reduce operator copy/paste by making review targets and dispositions durable and GitHub-native.
acceptance_criteria: Immediate quota exhaustion is treated as an infrastructure availability failure only; scientific/implementation authority is not widened to bypass validation.

The emergency public-repository window is temporary and does not weaken owner-only commands, exact SHA checks, same-repository PR-head checks, fork execution prohibitions, or other existing admission controls.
A stable bootstrap/control authority exists below the dynamic JIT fleet so reconciliation never depends on a runner whose own existence requires that reconciliation.

workspace-control gains a bounded self-hosted validation path without granting it access to research-engine, PADataset, GPU devices, operator home, Docker sockets, provisioner state, or sibling project roots.
Routine control validation has an explicit small CPU/RAM/runtime budget and bounded concurrency; increased workflow volume creates queue depth rather than unbounded simultaneous execution.
research-engine and PADataset keep project-scoped execution identities and filesystem/security isolation even if GitHub-side runner registration later moves to organization scope.
All remaining ubuntu-latest workflows are inventoried and either migrated, intentionally retained as emergency bootstrap, or explicitly justified.
The long-term GitHub organization design uses runner groups and repository/workflow restrictions so GitHub-side runner authorization is at least as narrow as current per-repository routing.

Organization migration is reversible and separately gated; repository transfer, runner re-registration, credential changes, and workflow owner-path changes are not bundled into the first live migration.
Pre-implementation and implementation reviews can be requested and consumed from durable GitHub state without the operator manually copying review text between chats.
No live host mutation or runner activation occurs before the exact design receives independent review; design-only and NOT_INSTALLED scaffolding are allowed.
After migration, private repositories can operate routine CI without consuming GitHub-hosted Actions minutes except explicitly retained emergency/fallback workflows.
constraints: Do not alter Local EXTRACT scientific design, benchmark contents, result interpretation, trigger authority, or sealed acceptance data.
Do not use quota exhaustion as justification to skip required validation or independent review.
Do not let a dynamically reconciled workspace-control runner become the sole authority that approves the policy required to create itself.
Do not attach unrestricted self-hosted runners to public repositories; the temporary public window is an emergency billing/bootstrap workaround only.
Do not expose /home/atrott, Docker sockets, sibling project roots, root reconciler/provisioner state, trusted model caches, or GPU devices to routine control CI.
Do not increase project/lane execution concurrency without an explicit resource and isolation review.
Do not perform GitHub organization migration in the same change that first proves the dedicated workspace-control self-hosted lane.
Prefer GitHub App credentials with least privilege over broad PATs for any later organization-scoped runner control.
Keep durable task capsules, exact Git identities, workflow blobs, receipts, and policy artifacts authoritative; runner labels or organization membership do not create execution authority.

A review bot or Copilot review may reduce operator work but cannot silently satisfy a task contract that explicitly requires an independent scientific/architecture reviewer unless that contract is amended and independently accepted.
